configuration.timeBasis: from 1972 to 2027-10-02, TT from the leap seconds and UT1 from IERS UT1 − UTC; the ΔT model otherwise
configuration.timeZones: before 1970 the shipped tzdb 2025c history (main+backzone), loaded with prepareLocalTime; from 1970 the host's Intl time zone data (Node 22.22.2, ICU 78.2, tz 2025c)
configuration.positions: natalChart with timeScale "tt": the requested instant is read as TT
configuration.angles: natalChart with timeScale "ut1": the requested instant is read as UT1
